record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
I rebuilt `site/public/prices.html`. The page lists **6 products**, and the cheapest one is **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The listed products, from cheapest to most expensive:

| Product | Price |
|---|---|
| Fable pencil set | 7.60 |
| Bramble journal | 8.90 |
| Ivy plant pot | 13.20 |
| Anchor mug | 14.50 |
| Dune tote bag | 24.00 |
| Gale scarf | 31.50 |

Two products in `data/products.json` are cheaper, Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20), but they're marked inactive, so the page leaves them out. Two other inactive products are left out as well.

The script has to be run from inside `site/` (`cd site && node build.js`) because it looks up its files relative to the current directory. I didn't change `build.js`.
